<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:camunda="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/bpmn" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn" exporter="@bpmnkit/core" exporterVersion="0.0.23">
  <bpmn:process id="KycOnboarding" camunda:versionTag="1.0.0" name="KYC Onboarding Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Onboarding Started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_dzvGWk3K</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="uploadDocument" name="Upload Identity Document">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_dzvGWk3K</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_rlKvyhN6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_jFSBMYJb</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="verifyDocument" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="io.camunda:http-json:1" name="Verify Document (OCR)">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="authentication.type">bearer</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="authentication.token">=secrets.OCR_SERVICE_TOKEN</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="method">POST</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="url">=ocrServiceUrl + "/verify"</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="connectionTimeoutInSeconds">20</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="readTimeoutInSeconds">20</camunda:inputParameter>
        </camunda:inputOutput>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_jFSBMYJb</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1TTrGjjw</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="qualityGateway" name="Document Verified?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1TTrGjjw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_0LEUQOxJ</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_mYkhul6F</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="retryGateway" name="Retries Remaining?" default="Flow_uHPpRk4d">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_mYkhul6F</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S3pkDgDT</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_uHPpRk4d</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:scriptTask id="incrementRetry" name="Increment Retry Count">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S3pkDgDT</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_rlKvyhN6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:scriptTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="sendVerificationRejection" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="email-sender" name="Send Verification Rejection">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="to">=applicant.email</camunda:inputParameter>
        </camunda:inputOutput>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_uHPpRk4d</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_tODzlPDa</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endRejectedDocument" name="Rejected — Document">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_tODzlPDa</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="sanctionsScreening" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="io.camunda:http-json:1" name="Sanctions & PEP Screening">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="authentication.type">bearer</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="authentication.token">=secrets.SCREENING_SERVICE_TOKEN</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="method">POST</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="url">=screeningServiceUrl + "/screen"</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="connectionTimeoutInSeconds">20</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="readTimeoutInSeconds">20</camunda:inputParameter>
        </camunda:inputOutput>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_0LEUQOxJ</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IRsmpnbh</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IRsmpnbh</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8vSOCU50</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P4BQYrEw</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="standardDueDiligence" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="due-diligence-service" name="Standard Due Diligence">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="applicantId">=applicant.id</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:outputParameter name="dueDiligenceResult">=ddResult</camunda:outputParameter>

      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8vSOCU50</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_K56CWSVL</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="enhancedDueDiligence" name="Enhanced Due Diligence Review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P4BQYrEw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01TCJkY6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="finalRiskClassification" name="Final Risk Classification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5Xnykddu</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_afmDHVqD</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:businessRuleTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="outcomeGateway" name="Final Decision?" default="Flow_RGXncTod">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_afmDHVqD</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_nsEpR6Kw</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NgrHE8n7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RGXncTod</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

        <camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="applicantId">=applicant.id</camunda:inputParameter>
        </camunda:inputOutput>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_nsEpR6Kw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_hyA4P19S</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="endApproved" name="Approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_hyA4P19S</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="escalateToCompliance" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="compliance-notifier" name="Escalate to Compliance">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="applicantId">=applicant.id</camunda:inputParameter>
        </camunda:inputOutput>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NgrHE8n7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_jEsjEcCl</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endEscalated" name="Escalated to Compliance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_jEsjEcCl</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="sendKycRejection" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="email-sender" name="Send KYC Rejection">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="to">=applicant.email</camunda:inputParameter>
        </camunda:inputOutput>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RGXncTod</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LtOjKgN2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endRejected" name="Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LtOjKgN2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="dueDiligenceGateway_join">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_K56CWSVL</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01TCJkY6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5Xnykddu</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_dzvGWk3K" sourceRef="start" targetRef="uploadDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_jFSBMYJb" sourceRef="uploadDocument" targetRef="verifyDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1TTrGjjw" sourceRef="verifyDocument" targetRef="qualityGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_0LEUQOxJ" sourceRef="qualityGateway" targetRef="sanctionsScreening" name="document-verified">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=ocrResponse.verified = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_mYkhul6F" sourceRef="qualityGateway" targetRef="retryGateway" name="document-failed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=ocrResponse.verified = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S3pkDgDT" sourceRef="retryGateway" targetRef="incrementRetry" name="retry-upload">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=retryCount < 2</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_rlKvyhN6" sourceRef="incrementRetry" targetRef="uploadDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_uHPpRk4d" sourceRef="retryGateway" targetRef="sendVerificationRejection" name="retries-exhausted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_tODzlPDa" sourceRef="sendVerificationRejection" targetRef="endRejectedDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IRsmpnbh" sourceRef="sanctionsScreening" targetRef="dueDiligenceGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8vSOCU50" sourceRef="dueDiligenceGateway" targetRef="standardDueDiligence" name="standard-dd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=screeningResponse.riskLevel = "low" and screeningResponse.isPep = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_K56CWSVL" sourceRef="standardDueDiligence" targetRef="dueDiligenceGateway_join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P4BQYrEw" sourceRef="dueDiligenceGateway" targetRef="enhancedDueDiligence" name="enhanced-dd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01TCJkY6" sourceRef="enhancedDueDiligence" targetRef="dueDiligenceGateway_join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_afmDHVqD" sourceRef="finalRiskClassification" targetRef="outcomeGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_nsEpR6Kw" sourceRef="outcomeGateway" targetRef="activateAccount" name="outcome-approved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=finalClassification.decision = "approve"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_hyA4P19S" sourceRef="activateAccount" targetRef="endApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NgrHE8n7" sourceRef="outcomeGateway" targetRef="escalateToCompliance" name="outcome-escalated">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=finalClassification.decision = "escalate"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_jEsjEcCl" sourceRef="escalateToCompliance" targetRef="endEscalated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RGXncTod" sourceRef="outcomeGateway" targetRef="sendKycRejection" name="outcome-rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LtOjKgN2" sourceRef="sendKycRejection" targetRef="endRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5Xnykddu" sourceRef="dueDiligenceGateway_join" targetRef="finalRiskClassification"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
